 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Contantment"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Contentment". (संतोष)

 
 
• **Example: **She found contentment in the simple pleasures of life.
 
 

 
• **"Contentment" **means a state of happiness and satisfaction. (संतोष)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of hard work, he finally achieved a sense of contentment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adopt **(गोद लेना): To legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

 
 
• **Example:** They decided to adopt a child from the orphanage.
 
 

 
• **Advertisement **(विज्ञापन ): A notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event.

 
 
• **Example: **The advertisement for the new smartphone was very appealing.
 
 

 
• **Container** (पात्र): An object that can be used to hold or transport something.

 
 
• **Example:** She used a container to store the leftover food.
